mapper.select: SELECT memory.session_id, memory.summary, memory.summarized_message_id, memory.created_at, memory.updated_at FROM diet_session_memory memory INNER JOIN diet_sessions session ON session.id = memory.session_id AND session.user_id = #{userId} WHERE memory.session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diet_session_memory ( session_id, summary, summarized_message_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{summary}, #{summarizedMessageId}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE summary = VALUES(summary), summarized_message_id = VALUES(summarized_message_id), updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO diet_user_memory ( user_id, memory_type, memory_key, memory_value, source_session_id, active, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{memoryType}, #{memoryKey}, #{memoryValue}, #{sourceSessionId}, 1, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE memory_value = VALUES(memory_value), source_session_id = VALUES(source_session_id), active = 1, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, memory_type, memory_key, memory_value, source_session_id, active, created_at, updated_at FROM diet_user_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND active = 1 ORDER BY FIELD(memory_type, 'ALLERGY', 'AVOID', 'GOAL', 'PREFERENCE'), updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
